QuestInfo.name: The Shadow Returns
QuestInfo.0: Speak to Sugar. She looks a little down.
QuestInfo.1: Sugar thinks something's wrong back in town. Rush over to Southperry!
QuestInfo.2: Sugar thinks something's wrong back in town. When you head back, you see the Shadow of the Black Mage!
